name: io.github.cyanheads/clipboard-mcp-server
description: Read, write, and inspect the system clipboard on macOS, Linux (X11/Wayland), and Windows via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Serve the clipboard read-only. When true, clipboard_write is not registered: it is absent from tools/list and uncallable, though still listed in a disabled state on the manifest and landing page. Accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum inbound JSON-RPC request body in bytes. Defaults to 7 MiB so a full-size clipboard_write survives worst-case JSON escaping; 0 disables the guard.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SESSION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: HTTP session mode: 'auto', 'stateful', or 'stateless'. 'auto' resolves to 'stateful'. This server defaults to 'stateless'.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Serve the clipboard read-only. When true, clipboard_write is not registered: it is absent from tools/list and uncallable, though still listed in a disabled state on the manifest and landing page. Accepts true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off.
